notes.title: Developer Update #5 - 25/09/2025
notes.notes:
Hey there, Survivors!

Welcome to our fifth Developer Update! Today, we’re excited to share a big look at what’s been cooking behind the scenes. Let’s dive right in!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/0ebbc6356ed04ccf188d9321bab0c033f4f2a593.png

Male Character & Armors

Up until now, the female character has been leading the way, but it’s time for reinforcements. The male character is officially joining the fight! Alongside this, we’re unveiling one of the biggest gameplay systems yet: armors. 🔥

Here’s a first look at two new armor sets designed for the male archetype, each offering distinct stats and playstyles to shape your survival strategy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/c31335c9654004492c4b3bd29f289db45d8d607e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/bc40fbb217b998c2bf6941fc58255ad2b87c2221.jpg

But that’s not all. Some of you eagle-eyed explorers may have spotted a motorbike in our last trailer 👀. Vehicles are a huge milestone for mobility, but we wanted to give you something to bridge the gap while exploring our vast worlds. Enter: backpacks! 🚀

Each backpack comes equipped with its own jetpack, giving you new ways to move, scout, and survive with style.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/991e25945ccadac8459e69e7254b99a0c75e75df.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/439295db066fcdad5b4b393c0d891046831e6006.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/be449989df0c3119e923eddd4679bf6afc50dde2.gif

Environment Concept Art

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/04aada18f76a2797346bcf844237a822d338f8cf.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/32558aa738503a28b980436d894ecf7c6a753a6d.png

Take a peek at some brand-new concept art showcasing the resources of Land of Symbiosis. 🌱

Alien plants will cover your essential survival needs, while rarer resources are the key to advanced progression, powering up your base, unlocking cutting-edge tech, crafting stronger armors, and forging weapons with serious bite.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/88673dbc7cf65057779269578a251e61eb83c3b5.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/fa5d0206b5137293e2974605864397e4d82cc8ae.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/116a73ffc47c737c9a4625dd7af85c3d32fb3b74.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/d43ddb3f56a14cfa69d76916d7718d183a8fc03f.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/70bcedcc5e12667ed3fb4dc87d9746071e14e327.jpg

That’s all for this update!

We hope you enjoyed this look at what’s coming to Land of Symbiosis. Development is moving fast, and we can’t wait for you to get your hands on these new systems soon.  

✅ Don’t forget to add the game to your Wishlist, it’s the best way to support us and stay up to date.  

Thanks,
~Land of Symbiosis Team

notes.title: Developer Update #4 - 15/07/2025
notes.notes:
Hey there, Survivors!

Today, we are coming to you with a fourth Developer Update to keep you in the loop on our development progress! Let's jump into it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/e651f245194c2c6c92ec9049868f8ea69fa1d27a.png

Concept Art

This month, the art team has been busy refining key visuals that shape the atmosphere of our world. New mood and biome-specific palettes, helping us nail down the look and feel of Sigma Century’s alien flora and environments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/96e9331e28f2ba0690bdea0d8d5a44073df173ef.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/f3e28aa3f1fca2ce429b74472f5bbcd26490b002.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/ba76e2d28bfb60ff2ff74bbdda3dedf49a6e82ba.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/14213352a689a3fd4fdfc53c220ceb356f835844.png

Environnements

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/b582fb934d2e69ac1b9411b09a2be8cc1a883acd.jpg

Not in-game footage, work in progress paint over of the creature's nest design.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/16a11c8540f5b0fc645c22d8771190121207c050.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/deef1975b11ab7d01b388a42d3fa5b7bf9e248c8.png

Some more iterations on our procedural environment pipeline. Now including large rock formations, modular terrain features, and vegetation clusters that dynamically adapt to each biome. This will help us keep environments fresh and varied throughout the game.

Creatures

Animation tests for our new creatures are in progress! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/4dc8bb1fe6a5b3c5d527a0a215eb2f8c7662e224.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/fca3c696bfac2fae1ef08cc508c50ee5dff37a08.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/d939a7e4331815fb4172a28783f8f351265bb637.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/5f436373c6809901debf2cdec319a5860feecbbe.gif

UI

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/065aa5009f9b22fe6bc44e579b0d8d1d6bbfadcc.png

Initial layout mockups are underway for the user interface around the Cycles, one of the game’s core pillars.

These cycles influence whether you’ll venture out to gather resources, hunt creatures roaming the world, or stay back and pray your base holds against the incoming swarm.

We’re prototyping different ways to present this information clearly and make sure players feel the pressure (and opportunity) each cycle brings.

Defenses

This week, we introduced the Turret Mk1 to our defensive toolkit.
It’s designed as an early-game, low-cost option: helpful for fending off small creatures or stray threats, but intentionally kept quite weak, so players still need to stay alert and actively defend their base.

The team is now playtesting its range, firing rate, and visual feedback to make sure it feels useful without making the early game too easy.

Concept

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/3350f575ad03747cc51ad098471bd8c89784955b.png

In progress modeling & texturing

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/23429553f3fd3baaddbdc8d0e8635cf78749a561.png

In Game previews

We’ve got some fresh in-game shots to share!
They show our new creature animations and early environment passes coming together. It’s still a work-in-progress, but it feels great to see things starting to click visually.

What do you think? We’d love to hear your first impressions and feedback!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/3c1e60b7c9624264630b2b17563fe02e34f44023.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/2870bc648b7463ab39bba367a057c38fae808d65.png

notes.title: Developer Update #3 - 18.06.2025
notes.notes:
Hey there, Survivors!

Today, we are coming to you with the third Developer Update to keep you in the loop on our development progress! Let's jump into it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/77e80dda8b7bf0578b9e003f01574eac300cfe77.png

Environment

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/878243ae940604ff289e49205f9a8bfd3ed16e2a.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/12216bc236a082b8b07fdbc313bbba032d5cd8e6.png

Our latest environment concept art is now finalized. What do you think?

With that in place, we've started building the rocky sub-biome you'll explore while searching for rare materials! It’s still early, but we’re excited to share the results as they evolve. The rocks are heavily inspired by Icelandic formations, with curved elements used to enhance the flow and dynamism.

Concept Art

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/78cf1b309b5ca5952fbe699220b573addbaf4fc3.jpg

We're working on “TAPER”, one of the first threats you’ll encounter.

It’s a bit dumb (not many brain cells left), but still accurate enough to tear through your defences. Watch out!

3D Modeling

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/05f5290216e8cbc5043dfb0dcbe3dd3f6a22b20f.png

Admire BULK’s final 3D form! 😄

With his massive arms and tank-like build, he's ready to smash through bases and soak up damage like a champ.

Now fully textured, he looks even cooler, and at four times the size of FLESH, BULK will be a real threat during swarm phases.

He naturally draws your defences' focus, which makes him the perfect distraction… while smaller creatures slip through.

Animation

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/65e8bec05fcaf621b791860838e3189124886a40.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/e3e1466648d99029fb2687ac0e10bfaae64abf1b.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/c2e39269dad6026b58beded859780c7fa6c95050.gif

We’re working on the first animations for FLESH,
and we can’t wait to get them in-game to show you how it all comes to life!

Development - New Weapon!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/2938396e08ce55cfdbdb7422aa88f88645d74524.jpg

We’ve been working on one of the first weapons you’ll be able to craft the good old Crossbow Mk1.
It’s not the most efficient tool out there, but hey, it’s still a big step up from using your fists!

Development - Research bench rework

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/b4b3c5e197c6b9e65d01b5aa373eee5ea0457720.png

We have reworked the research bench a little bit lately, mostly UX/UI and localization support.


Development Misc

We are also working on a lot of dev features that are not always so amusing to show, sadly. Here is still a small list of what we did : 

 Camera-based procedural splat map generation for terrain texturing
 Rework of the world entities layers and erasing system for generation
 A whooooole lot of new SFX for base building
 Reintegration of the hot bar and new UX designs
 A lot more work on localization


If that interests you, feel free to join our Discord and discuss with our developers directly! 😀

notes.title: Developer Update #2 - 05.06.2025
notes.notes:
Hey there, Survivors!

Today, we have a second Developer Update to keep you in the loop on our development progress! Let's jump into it!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/7cc7cf1cbb1b33451a9b00fb44f69c20acd5f08b.png"]


Creatures


- Finalized BULK Concept arts



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/ebe3f5c916f1111f77206a43515ab20626fcd1b0.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/a63fddc9e01e43a334f89e58c0615cadfca0fc73.png"]

Thanks to his massive arms, BULK will be able to smash your base and defenses while being an incredibly resistant creature. A living tank.

We also like to think he has some vibes of a good boy 

(His design is partially doggo.)



- WIP BULK 3D Modeling



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/8de4f14da4d716a1a97133a4c98c356d1c22a3f5.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/63c5afab82a37fa1427619322d7cbb87362bc251.png"]

Last week, we started the blocking phase of BULK. As you can see, it’s challenging to get the proportions right, especially since the back and arm armor must fit together for the shield assembly (see concepts above).



- FLESH enemy modeling & texturing is now complete!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/34f413f1b2f20982a0c944015b73806436407d91.jpg"]

Here’s a first look at the final sculpt and textures. We went for a sharp, aggressive silhouette with glowing inner details to give it a menacing presence.



At the same time, we focused on clean readability, as these creatures will often appear in large groups; it's essential that players can quickly identify and react to them in the heat of battle. What do you think of the look?


Environment


- WIP environment concepts



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/85564931f44528d6349f2ded5b869558feead318.png"]

We've made solid progress on the environment!

This is 3D blockout for our next concept art, which will feature ground rifts and more dramatic rock formations. It's still rough, but we're excited about the direction we're taking. What do you think?



Here are some color variations, feel free to mark your favourite!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/83f30381250aab02535c0a1be9c79a29314d1c03.jpg"]
Localization


As part of our preparation for an upcoming event 😶‍🌫️, we've been working on localizing Land of Symbiosis into new specific languages. While there's still some polishing to do, the localization systems are already in place.



As a result, the Q3 playtest will be available in the following languages:



 English

 French

 German

 Spanish

 Russian

 Portuguese

 Japanese

 Korean

 Simplified Chinese


Network optimisations


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/3b0d03d1b5b6766f9c5c98cbf71dd0c95733494f.jpg"]

Performance is a core priority in Land of Symbiosis, especially since we aim to simulate hundreds, if not thousands, of enemies simultaneously.



To support this, we've implemented a system that pre-computes major navigation data during the server’s initial loading phase. This significantly reduces runtime overhead and improves in-game performance despite having a runtime-generated procedural world.



Additionally, we've optimised how static elements of the environment are handled. These elements are now excluded from the network entirely, relying instead on the world seed and procedural generation to pre-pool them locally on each client. This approach reduces bandwidth usage and minimises latency when loading chunks around the player while increasing memory usage slightly for the client.



Thank you for your time and support. We hope you liked our new Developer update! See you in the next one!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/664ec46cc07459fdb219f5d18a0914f583cfa776.jpg"]

notes.title: Development Update #1 - 20/05/2025
notes.notes:
Hey there, Survivors!

Today, we are coming to you with a quick DevUpdate to keep you in the loop on our development progress! Let's jump into it!

Creatures

- New creature named “B.U.L.K.” concepts

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/3e3a265a00d4f8c8a4f04cf73522a86ac286096b.png

BULK stands for “Bulwark Unstoppable Lifeform Kolossus” and will be one of the first monsters to truly test your abilities in combat and base defense setup. Its shell on his back and arms allows him to take the form of a living shield, luring your defenses while smaller creatures can destroy them in the meantime.

- Finalised creature “F.L.E.S.H.” concepts

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/7f50ec0a9c21b60b400b048252d1e197d63c6cb3.jpg

FLESH stands for “Functional Living Entity for Sacrificial Hostilities” 
They behave like ants,  fast, disposable, and individually weak, but extremely dangerous when swarming in massive groups. As the first enemy players will face, they serve as an early stress test for defences and demand quick area control and positioning.

Work in progress FLESH 3D modeling

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/3446489a0bf6cf6df48f4b6ad4f45910d60146ae.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/15ee12b679fb492b2ae2f7201da533ca56ba7431.jpg

High Poly modeling ✅ | Low Poly ⌛| Mid Poly ⌛| Texturing ⌛

Environment

- Environment Design work in progress

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/dbed0525f4fd325584a217ffc48c2f799293501b.png

We are working on some new moods and assets for the first environment you will encounter.

World

Regarding the world, some improvements were made; we have been working on navigation baking and network optimizations to make sure the game runs as fast as possible during gameplay. This is important for us, given the number of enemies you can encounter during swarm cycles.

We are also working on a new system regarding procedural generation of the forests. This new system will allow us to generate more realistic-looking vegetation placement around trees using SDFs and hierarchies while being fully customizable by our artists.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/6d7c1ab2e49bc090a4db7f092efb8ce54eb934f6.png

Base Building

For those of you that tested the game during the first closed playtest. You will notice a huge change in the base building mechanic. We heard your feedback and worked on a more modular, fun and creative base building system.

This new system is based on a 1x1 grid and not on a 4x4 grid anymore. This allows the player to create everything he wants, giving a lot more of creativity for base defense and decoration.

Temporary visuals
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/4559e75826b3e55fcac43ffa1ad79f320ebdf8e2.jpg
 
Fog Of War

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/a43126cf272b88516967f87099399b735d6e9a84.gif

We developed more visually interesting effects and introduced a new, lightweight method for handling fog of war.

Traditionally, fog of war is implemented by painting circular masks onto a texture that represents the world from a top-down view. This texture is then used to display explored areas. However, saving and transmitting this texture, especially when a player joins a game in progress, can be costly in terms of memory and bandwidth.

Our approach subdivides the world into cells. Whenever a player enters a new cell, we mark it as visited.

 We then dispatch a compute shader that generates a render texture at runtime using smoothmin functions based on the center positions of the visited cells.

 💾 This allows us to save and transmit only the IDs of the visited cells to each client, who can then generate the fog of war texture locally.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/0bc5d17ea3e29c0d2ab8f19e55ac5f8464203678.png

Would you be interested in a detailed devlog about procedural generation? This is quite a huge topic, and we could share a lot of interesting insights about it!

notes.title: DEV Update : New Weapon - Shock Blades ⚡⚔️
notes.notes:
Hello Early Survivors! 🔥

⬇️ Here is a first preview of the new Shock Blades that will be available to play in the demo. ⬇️

https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExazJjcjhid3NzOXVxNHg5NDdiOXFoNzB1NGJpNXF2YXl2c3Q0eGNkciZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/7KPKQpas9d6QanYJt4/giphy.gif

This is a sneak peek of the elemental system available for you to customize your weapons and their afflictions. 

Key Features of the Shock Blades

Electrical Element: Infuse your attacks with shocking power to stun and damage your enemies.
Dual-Wielding: Master the art of dual blades for fast and fluid combat.
Gameplay Impact
The Shock Blades will revolutionize your combat strategy. Unleash electrifying combos and control the battlefield by stunning foes, giving you the upper hand in critical moments.

We Want Your Feedback!
Join our Discord server and let us know your thoughts! Your feedback is crucial in shaping the future of Land of Symbiosis.

Stay Connected
If you haven't already, don't forget to wishlist and follow Land of Symbiosis to stay updated with the latest news and updates.

See you soon for more updates!
